description: This file defines the TensorIterator class and related configuration and helper classes for element-wise tensor operations, including broadcasting, type promotion, and dimension management within the ATen library of PyTorch.

classes.name: OperandInfo
classes.description: Holds information about tensor operands, including data pointers, strides, device, and dtype, used during tensor iteration.

classes.name: TensorIteratorBase
classes.description: Base class managing tensor iteration logic, shape, dimension permutation, and operand management for element-wise operations.

classes.name: TensorIterator
classes.description: Derived class providing static methods for common tensor operations and managing iteration over tensors.

classes.name: TensorIteratorConfig
classes.description: Builder class for configuring tensor iteration parameters, including inputs, outputs, dtype, device, shape, and iteration options.

classes.name: SplitUntil32Bit
classes.description: Helper struct to split a TensorIterator into sub-iterators that can use 32-bit indexing.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs a TensorIterator based on the configuration.

methods.name: add_output
methods.description: Adds an output tensor to the iteration configuration.

methods.name: add_input
methods.description: Adds an input tensor to the iteration configuration.

methods.name: set_check_mem_overlap
methods.description: Sets whether to check for memory overlaps among tensors.

methods.name: check_all_same_dtype
methods.description: Checks if all tensors have the same dtype.

methods.name: check_all_same_device
methods.description: Checks if all tensors are on the same device.

methods.name: enforce_safe_casting_to_output
methods.description: Enforces safe casting rules for output tensors.

methods.name: promote_inputs_to_common_dtype
methods.description: Promotes all inputs to a common dtype for the operation.

methods.name: promote_integer_inputs_to_float
methods.description: Promotes integer inputs to float dtype.

methods.name: declare_static_dtype_and_device
methods.description: Fixes the dtype and device for iteration.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds a TensorIterator from the configuration.
